originalSubject: Re: Hashtag Web3: publisher onboarding and automatic news-feed distribution

payload.subject: Re: Hashtag Web3: publisher onboarding and automatic news-feed distribution
payload.text:
Hello CoinCarp team,

Thank you for the context. To support the case-by-case review, here are the specific points you listed, stated for our side:

- Attribution: we require attribution to Hashtag Web3 as publisher with a canonical link to the original article (no unattributed republication).
- Canonical links: every feed item carries the canonical URL of the original story on hashtagweb3.com.
- Feed specification: RSS 2.0 at https://hashtagweb3.com/news/feed.xml with headline, summary, original publication date, and canonical link.
- Content rights: our native articles are ours to distribute; where a story embeds third-party material we follow licensing rules. We can provide image-rights information for our original images on request.
- AI disclosure: our workflow uses AI-assisted research and drafting with source and publication checks; we can complete your AI-disclosure forms or statements as required.
- Contractual terms: happy to review and sign your standard onboarding or syndication agreement on behalf of Hashtag Web3 (United States organization).

Scope note: our news listing also links to external publishers; those external stories are not supplied as our own content.

Publication: https://hashtagweb3.com/news
About: https://hashtagweb3.com/about
Example native article: https://hashtagweb3.com/bitgetthai

We understand you cannot confirm acceptance from the support inbox - please route this review package to the appropriate team, and let us know if any additional form or file is needed from our side.

Thank you,
Hashtag Web3 - hi@hashtagweb3.com
